description: We are a team of Nanobiologists that have come together to combine our passion for science, technology, and programming in order to solve big problems with small scale solutions.
summary:
Astrocyte is a health monitoring dashboard designed to help astronauts understand their health and manage routine assessments during space missions. It brings together muscular strength, reaction time, overnight heart-rate variability, sleep scores, estimated VO₂ max and menstrual cycle tracking in one accessible interface. Astronauts can view their current readings and look back at previous data to see their progress. 

The app guides them through the steps needed to collect new measurements and sends reminders so none are forgotten. Clicking on a task opens clear step by step instructions for completing it.

A base map shows them where to take each test and displays the conditions inside and outside the base. From the collected data, Astrocyte calculates a general health score, allowing astronauts to quickly assess their operational fitness. All data is readily accessible, and quick summaries are available at a glance, with suggested remedies for any issues
details:
Astrocyte

How does it work?

Astrocyte displays astronaut health data, environmental conditions and medical tasks into one dashboard. Crew members can explore their health trends, be reminded of tasks on an interactive map of their mars base, and get personalized recommendations based on their health issues. Astrocyte also teaches them how to perform medical tests and measurements so that they can collect consistent health data more independently.

Benefits

Astrocyte gives astronauts greater control of their individual health, by including all of their biomarkers and health recordings in one easy to navigate location. Clear summaries, task reminders and a composite health score make information easier to navigate and act on, as well as how to perform these tests.

Intended impact

We aim to support astronaut autonomy during long duration missions by making routine health monitoring more accessible and organised. Astrocyte helps crew members recognize changes over time and keep track of their scheduled assessments.

Tools used

We built Astrocyte around a Python and Streamlit workflow, using ChatGPT to assist in making the SVG habitat map. We generated synthetic health data based off of spaceflight research since astronaut health vitals are private. The environmental condition values came from NASA’s Mars Explorer giving us insight into radiation and conditions on mars that could affect astronauts health.

Creativity

Our interactive Mars base links health tasks to an astronaut’s physical location, showing them explicitly where to perform their daily checkups, and reminding them of their healthcare requirements. This turns a conventional dashboard into a visual overview eliminating any barriers that could arise in a crew member’s health journey.

AI Assistance

  • Synthetic health data: ChatGPT generated demonstration values using the publications and NASA resources listed above as context since personal health data is private.
  • Habitat map: the SVG habitat illustration was AI assisted using ChatGPT
  • Design and documentation: ChatGPT assisted with dashboard design concepts and drafting
